sloka: तमुवाच महातेजाः कुम्भयोनिर्महातपाः ।स्वागतं ते नरश्रेष्ठ दिष्ट्या प्राप्तो ऽसि राघव ।। ७.७६.२५ ॥
transliteration: tamuvāca mahātejāḥ kumbhayonirmahātapāḥ ।svāgataṁ te naraśreṣṭha diṣṭyā prāpto 'si rāghava ।। 7.76.25 ॥

translations.english: The greatly effulgent and great ascetic Agastya said to him, "Welcome to you, O best among men, O scion of Raghu, fortunately you have arrived."
